page.notes: Printed line numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35 are in the left margin of the text and placed at their lines. Greek words are copied as far as legible; (ἠγόρασας), (ἐῤῥύσατο) and "detq;" in Matth. 10.28 are doubtful. The v/u and i/j spelling was normalised by rule (e.g. Ioh→Joh, Iesus→Jesus, vt→ut). Verse references are as printed. The blot over "Dignus" in Apoc. 5.9 is a stain and is not transcribed. Left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are excluded.
